# KitLuy Open Decisions and Required Values Register

**Filename:** `kitluy-open-decisions-and-required-values-v1.0.0.md`  
**Version:** v1.0.0  
**Date:** 2026-07-26  
**Owner:** HET / KitLuy Suite Project Owner  
**Status:** CANONICAL OPEN-VALUE REGISTER  
**Scan scope:** 25 KitLuy owner, specification, registry and retained-bible sources  
**Required-value occurrences captured:** 825  
**Deduplicated requirement keys:** 730

## 1. Rule

Every `[REQUIRED: ...]` or unlabeled `[REQUIRED]` value is unresolved until an authorized owner supplies evidence or a versioned decision. Agents must not guess, synthesize or copy a competitor value into production configuration.

This register excludes competitor clone/rebuild documents because their placeholders are not KitLuy required values unless separately adopted.

## 3. Resolution protocol

For each resolved value, record:

- requirement ID;
- approved value or decision;
- owner and approver;
- effective date and environment;
- evidence location;
- affected documents/configuration;
- secret classification, if applicable;
- validation/test result;
- superseded value, if any.

Never place secret values in this Markdown file. Store only secret references and ownership metadata.

## 6. Closure states

| State                 | Meaning                                                  |
| --------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------- |
| OPEN                  | No approved value exists                                 |
| OPTIONS-PROPOSED      | Nonbinding options exist                                 |
| OWNER-APPROVED        | Approved decision/value exists but may not be configured |
| CONFIGURED-DEV        | Present and verified in development                      |
| CONFIGURED-STAGING    | Present and verified in staging                          |
| CONFIGURED-PRODUCTION | Present and verified in production                       |
| SUPERSEDED            | Replaced by a newer approved value                       |
| NOT-APPLICABLE        | Owner approved that the value is not required            |
